note: Security Overhaul SKSE - Extra Locks (11 New Locks) v1.0. FOMOD required files are meshes/ and ExtraLocks_LID.ini; the only choice is the texture group, taken at 2k. Adds Vampire, Dawnguard, Farmhouse, Display Case, Imperial, Orc, Generic Chest, Upper Class Chest, Snowy Chest, Noble Chest and Snowy Nordic locks. Asset-only: no DLL, no plugin. RETIERED 2026-09-06 from 1k to 2k after the user's texture-policy directive ("treat the texture limits less as limits and more as ideal. The lockpicking interface is pretty large so having high res locksmithing is normal"): these assets are drawn at high screen coverage in the lockpicking view, so the small-clutter default does not fit them. 2048 stays under the 4096 hard ceiling. 4k was not taken - it is 22 MB per map against 5.5 MB at 2k, and 2k is what the surveyed lists that tag a tier (Nolvus) use.
